name: Freelance / Free-Zone Work Permits

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a freelance permit from a participating free zone (e.g. SHAMS, RAKEZ, IFZA, DMCC, TECOM zones), which functions as the licensing basis for an associated residence visa.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a freelance permit through a participating free zone.

evidence_required.document: Free-zone freelance permit application (portfolio/CV, business activity description)

outcome.duration_length: 1-3 years depending on the specific free zone

sources.title: Free zones - The Official Portal of the UAE Government

notes: SOURCING CAVEAT flagged honestly: this is genuinely NOT a single federal scheme the way most other UAE routes in this dataset are — each free zone (Dubai Media City, Dubai Internet City, Dubai Knowledge Park, SHAMS Sharjah, RAKEZ, IFZA, Ajman, Fujairah Creative City, DMCC, twofour54, and others) runs its own commercial freelance-permit product with its own pricing and terms, making this route file a genuine aggregation of a fragmented landscape rather than one clean government process. Cost ranges reported during research varied widely (roughly AED 5,750 to AED 27,049 for year-one permit costs alone across different zones) — not encoded as a single fee here given the genuine zone-by-zone variance. LIVE OPERATIONAL NOTE, not fully confirmed at tier-1 precision: some Dubai TECOM-affiliated zones (Media City, Internet City, Knowledge Park) reportedly paused new individual freelance permit registrations as of the underlying research — flagged as a real gap requiring direct confirmation with the specific zone before relying on this route. Direct feeder into ae_green_visa's freelancer group once the AED 360,000/2-year income threshold is met.
